# checkpointsase_application_control_applications (Data Source)

List the applications Check Point SASE's Application Control can recognise, for use in Internet Access (SWG) policy. This is a read-only product catalog and is the same for every tenant — it is not the list of Application Access applications a tenant has created, which is `checkpointsase_applications`. The endpoint accepts no filter or pagination parameters, so this data source returns the whole catalog in one read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "checkpointsase_application_control_applications" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `applications` (List of Object) The list of Application Control applications. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--applications))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
